'''Team Razor''' was an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] unit. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the team established [[Outpost Cinder]]. Team Razor was commanded by a [[Major/Legends|major]], and included the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Razke]], [[Acle]], [[Reku]], [[Jal]], [[Henle]], and a new recruit.<ref name="HS" />
